input: Start a language learning streak on Duolingo today

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which language they want to learn determines which course to set up and how much prior knowledge they bring, affecting where they start in Duolingo.
Whether this is for themselves, a child, or someone else changes the account setup, parental controls, and motivational approach.
Knowing if they already have a Duolingo account changes the first step — setup vs. jumping straight into a lesson.
How much time they can commit each day directly determines which daily XP goal to set (Basic, Regular, Serious, or Intense) and whether the streak is realistic.
Their underlying motivation (travel, career, family, fun) shapes which learning style, course features, and reminders will keep them engaged long-term.
Knowing their target streak length or fluency milestone defines what 'done well' looks like and helps set milestones to celebrate along the way.
Which device they plan to use (phone, tablet, desktop) affects how they set up notifications and streak reminders, which are critical to not breaking the streak.

gold.taskTitle: Start a Duolingo language learning streak today
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to begin and maintain a daily Duolingo streak, starting today.

questions.title: Which language are you planning to learn on Duolingo?
questions.description: Identifies the specific course to set up, and whether they are a complete beginner or have prior knowledge to place out of early levels.

questions.title: Do you already have a Duolingo account set up?
questions.description: Determines whether the first action is creating an account or simply opening the app and starting a lesson today.

questions.title: Is this streak for you or someone else, like a child?
questions.description: Clarifies whose account is being used and whether parental or shared account considerations apply.

questions.title: How many minutes per day can you realistically commit?
questions.description: Determines the right daily XP goal setting (5, 10, 15, or 20+ minutes) so the streak target is achievable rather than aspirational.

questions.title: What is your main reason for learning this language?
questions.description: Surfaces the core motivation — travel, work, family, or fun — which shapes which Duolingo features and lesson types to prioritise.

questions.title: What streak length or skill level signals success to you?
questions.description: Defines the finish line — whether that is a 30-day streak, 365 days, conversational ability, or a specific Duolingo course completion.

questions.title: Which device will you primarily use for your daily lessons?
questions.description: Determines how to configure streak reminders and notifications — push alerts on mobile vs. browser reminders on desktop — to prevent accidentally breaking the streak.
